Invariance to rapid astronaut hand movement and edge camera jitter
Robustness to hand occluding target sample or container opening during grasp

augmentation_dimensions.purpose: Invariance to oblique or overhead camera pitch angles

evaluation_subsets.description: Standard upright 0 deg orientation, standard lighting, no occlusion (unperturbed baseline)
Partial and full hand-object visual occlusions
Bright, Dim, and Shadow illumination conditions
Side, Overhead, and Oblique camera mounting angles

required_metrics.definition: Precision per angle theta in {0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270} across all 5 canonical actions
Recall per angle theta in {0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270} across all 5 canonical actions
Harmonic mean of precision and recall per angle theta
Mean F1 score averaged across all 7 evaluation angles
Delta F1_theta = F1_theta - F1_0deg representing performance change relative to baseline
Maximum drop between 0 deg baseline F1 and the lowest F1 among all 7 angles
Percentage of incomplete actions incorrectly classified as valid step completions under perturbation
Added milliseconds per frame when orientation rectification preprocessing is active

rules: All physical recordings and camera viewpoints for a given subject_id belong exclusively to one split (TRAIN, VALIDATION, or TEST).
Any synthetic transformation or augmentation (rotation, scale, lighting, blur) inherits the exact split of its parent source recording.
No augmented derivative of a TRAIN clip may ever appear in VALIDATION or TEST splits.
Evaluation orientation datasets must come exclusively from held-out TEST split subjects.
